Posted 'TT' dested Transmission Terminated and 'TT/OOC' the combo Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Do or do not combo' dested Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (the only Do, Or Do Not combo); 'YISYW' and 'Staging Areas' are posted as separate cards and dested the separate Effects; 'Yarna' dested Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'HFTMF' Heading For The Medical Frigate.
